title: Recombinant human thymosin beta-4 (rhTβ4) improved scalp condition and microbiome homeostasis in seborrheic dermatitis

printed_heading.text: Recombinant human thymosin beta-4 (rhTb4) improved scalp condition and microbiome homeostasis in seborrheic dermatitis Rui Yu,1 Qingbin Lin,1 Yanfang Zhai,1 Yunyun Mao,1 Kai Li,1 Yuemei Gao,1 Yanhong Liu,1 Ling Fu,1 Ting Fang,1 Mengsu Zhao,1 Lei Guan,2 Lihua Hou,1 Junjie Xu1 and Wei Chen1 1 Beijing Institute of Biotechnology, Beijing, China. 2 Guangzhou Landproof testing technology Co., Ltd., Guangzhou, China.

what_it_measured.text: We investigated the beneﬁt of a 4-week treatment with 0.5 mg ml-1 recombinant human thymosin b4 (rhTb4) gel or 2% ketoconazole lotion on the scalp condition of 71 patients with SD compared with 21 healthy individuals.

In this study, scalp microbiota alterations were measured in SD, showing signiﬁcantly greater abundance of Malassezia and Staphylococcus and diminished fungal and bacterial diversity compared with healthy controls.

dose.text: We investigated the beneﬁt of a 4-week treatment with 0.5 mg ml-1 recombinant human thymosin b4 (rhTb4) gel or 2% ketoconazole lotion on the scalp condition of 71 patients with SD compared with 21 healthy individuals.
We concluded that after a 4-week treatment period, 0.5 mg ml-1 rhTb4 gel was signiﬁcantly superior to 2% ketoconazole lotion in the treatment of subjects with seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp.

route.text: results of the present study showed that topical rhTb4 gel was superior to topical ketoconazole and can be considered as an alternative therapeutic modality in the treatment of scalp SD.

endpoint.text: Clinical assessment (Adherent Scalp Flaking Score, and the Maximum Erythema Area) and physiological conditions (transepidermal water loss, hydration, and sebum secretion) were evaluated.

In this study, scalp microbiota alterations were measured in SD, showing signiﬁcantly greater abundance of Malassezia and Staphylococcus and diminished fungal and bacterial diversity compared with healthy controls.
